results.overview: Across continents and decades, five brilliant friends make earth-shattering discoveries as the laws of science unravel and an existential threat emerges.
results.name: 3 Body Problem

results.overview: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.
results.name: Silo

results.overview: In the 1980s, a young Ferran Adrià happens to enter the kitchens of elBulli. What begins as a temporary job turns into the start of a gastronomic revolution that will forever change his life—and the history of cooking worldwide. Decades later, in 2025, Glòria Canabach—a retired critic haunted by guilt—returns from the United States following her father’s death. There, she reconnects with her niece, Lola, and together they decide to reopen the family restaurant, Can Canabach. As Ferran bids farewell to elBulli and Glòria seeks to forgive herself, both will find in the kitchen a way to heal and start anew.
results.name: Welcome to El Bulli

results.overview: Follow the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon, a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian" whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble.
results.name: The Lowdown

results.overview: The story revolves around Bhuvan and his family's everyday lives, when an unexpected purchase leads to a series of events and depicts every common man's larger than life dreams.
results.name: Dhindora

results.overview: Sophie trades New England for East Texas and falls into a wealthy socialite's magnetic orbit — where a clique of housewives hide deadly secrets.
results.name: The Hunting Wives

results.overview: In Pazos, Irene is brutally attacked, and Civil Guard sergeant Elías suspects her husband Aniceto, racing against time to uncover the truth before it’s too late.
results.name: Murder in Galicia

results.overview: Follow the aftermath of a brutal Christmas Eve crime and its impact on a rural Polish community.
results.name: Silent Night

results.overview: Follows Bill and Liz Rich who move to a remote Welsh farmhouse in 1989 for a fresh start, but after Liz sees a ghostly figure during a traumatic home birth, they face escalating paranormal disturbances.
results.name: The Witch Farm

results.overview: A riveting police drama about the men and women of the Chicago Police Department's District 21 who put it all on the line to serve and protect their community. District 21 is made up of two distinctly different groups: the uniformed cops who patrol the beat and go head-to-head with the city's street crimes and the Intelligence Unit that combats the city's major offenses - organized crime, drug trafficking, high profile murders and beyond.
results.name: Chicago P.D.

results.overview: After the party of heroes defeated the Demon King, they restored peace to the land and returned to lives of solitude. Generations pass, and the elven mage Frieren comes face to face with humanity's mortality. She takes on a new apprentice and promises to fulfill old friends' dying wishes. Can an elven mind make peace with the nature of life and death? Frieren embarks on her quest to find out.
results.name: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End

results.overview: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.
results.name: East of Eden

results.overview: Yuji Itadori is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a classmate who has been attacked by curses, he eats the finger of Ryomen Sukuna, taking the curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with Ryomen Sukuna. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Satoru Gojo, Itadori is admitted to Tokyo Jujutsu High School, an organization that fights the curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a curse to exorcise a curse, a life from which he could never turn back.
results.name: JUJUTSU KAISEN

results.original_name: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～
results.overview: When a 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a truck, his story doesn't end there. Reincarnated in a new world as an infant, Rudy will seize every opportunity to live the life he's always wanted. Armed with new friends, some freshly acquired magical abilities, and the courage to do the things he's always dreamed of, he's embarking on an epic adventure—with all of his past experience intact!
results.name: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation

results.overview: The adventures of a late-20th-century New York City pizza delivery boy, Philip J. Fry, who, after being unwittingly cryogenically frozen for one thousand years, finds employment at Planet Express, an interplanetary delivery company in the retro-futuristic 31st century.
results.name: Futurama

results.overview: In 1991, years prior to the events of NCIS, Leroy Jethro Gibbs starts his career as a newly minted special agent at the fledgling NCIS Camp Pendleton office, where he forges his place on a gritty, ragtag team led by NCIS legend Mike Franks.
results.name: NCIS: Origins

results.overview: When star Korean spatial designer Lee Yubin loses everything, he heads off to a Japanese island. There, he meets Karin, a resilient strawberry farmer. Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.
results.name: Merry Berry Love

results.overview: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Jimmy Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.
results.name: Detective Conan

results.overview: Britain's best amateur bakers compete in the iconic white tent - all united in their aim to prove their baking skills and impress judges Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith.
results.name: The Great British Bake Off

results.overview: 1815. When her fiancé is wrongfully imprisoned and her rescue attempt ends in tragedy, Mercédès vows revenge against those who destroyed her life.
results.name: The Countess of Monte Cristo
